captions.formal: Heavy traffic flows in both directions along a multi-lane city road lined with yellow autumn foliage and tall residential buildings. A high-angle shot captures cars and trucks under bright sunlight, passing signs for Korea Lillies Engineering and Taxpark Insurance.
captions.sarcastic: Numerous cars and trucks glide through a city road lined with yellow autumn foliage, demonstrating the breathtaking efficiency of a multi-lane traffic jam under a bright sunny sky.
captions.humorous_tech: Cars and trucks stream through a multi-lane city road lined with yellow autumn foliage, attempting a high-latency deploy through the city center. It is a massive traffic merge with absolutely no code review.
captions.humorous_non_tech: Countless cars and trucks crowd a multi-lane city road lined with yellow autumn leaves, all rushing past the Korea Lillies Engineering sign like they are competing in a race that nobody is actually winning.

captions.formal: An orange kitten stands and walks toward a stationary camera through a wooded area with dirt ground and green foliage. Bright, dappled light filters through the overhead leaves as the kitten passes between thin tree trunks.
captions.sarcastic: An orange kitten embarks on a perilous journey through a wooded area, bravely navigating the treacherous distance toward a stationary camera across a few feet of dirt.
captions.humorous_tech: An orange kitten deploys itself from a sitting position to walk through a wooded area, navigating tree trunks and foliage like a slow-loading page finally reaching the camera.
captions.humorous_non_tech: An orange kitten stands up and marches through the woods, navigating the dirt and trees with the unwavering focus of a tiny forest king coming to collect his taxes.

captions.formal: A woman with her hair in a high bun sits at a white office desk. She focuses on a computer monitor and types on a keyboard.
captions.sarcastic: A woman with her hair in a high bun sits at an office desk, demonstrating the staggering thrill of typing on a keyboard while staring at a monitor. Truly a whirlwind of high-octane productivity.
captions.humorous_tech: A woman with her hair in a high bun sits at a white office desk, typing intently into her monitor like a developer debugging a critical prod incident in total silence.
captions.humorous_non_tech: A woman with her hair in a high bun sits at a white office desk and types away with the intense focus of someone who is definitely not pretending to be busy.

captions.formal: A white stream of water cascades over dark, jagged rocks in a lush natural environment. Green foliage and moss cling to the stone cliffs as mist surrounds the falling water.
captions.sarcastic: A white stream of water cascades over dark, jagged rocks in a lush environment, demonstrating the truly groundbreaking technique of falling downward. How daring of the water to maintain such a consistent pace.
captions.humorous_tech: A white stream of water deploys continuously over dark, jagged rocks in a lush environment. The flow maintains zero latency, pushing a steady data stream of mist across the mossy cliffs.
captions.humorous_non_tech: A white stream of water cascades over dark, jagged rocks in a lush green environment, committing to the downward plunge with the absolute confidence of someone who has no plan for the bottom.

captions.formal: An aerial camera glides toward a modern building with a curved facade and blue accent lighting within a city skyline at dusk. Other illuminated skyscrapers, including one with a colorful G logo, accompany the movement.
captions.sarcastic: An aerial camera glides toward a modern building with a curved facade and blue lighting, clearly admiring the architectural courage required to make a skyscraper look like a giant slide.
captions.humorous_tech: An aerial camera deploys a smooth glide toward a modern building with a curved facade and blue lighting, scanning the dusk city skyline for any render errors. It passes a skyscraper with a colorful G logo as it pushes the final view to production.
captions.humorous_non_tech: A camera glides through a dusk city skyline toward a modern building with a curved facade and blue lights, passing a colorful G logo like it is looking for a parking spot for a tiny plane.

captions.formal: White and grey gulls congregate on a concrete ledge overlooking blue water and distant mountains. Several dark-colored pigeons land and walk among the gulls as other birds fly above the ledge.
captions.sarcastic: A fleet of white and grey gulls claims a concrete ledge by the water, only to be graciously joined by a few dark-colored pigeons who clearly believe they belong in the elite circle.
captions.humorous_tech: White and grey gulls occupy a concrete ledge by the water, only for dark-colored pigeons to attempt a merge into the group, triggering several wing-fluttering merge conflicts.
captions.humorous_non_tech: A colony of white and grey gulls occupies a concrete ledge by the water, only for a few dark pigeons to stroll in like they own the place.

captions.formal: Large crowds of pedestrians cross multiple wide zebra crossings at a busy city intersection. Various vehicles, including a red bus and yellow taxi, navigate the perimeter of the pedestrian flow amidst large buildings and trees.
captions.sarcastic: Masses of pedestrians courageously flood a city intersection's zebra crossings, while a yellow taxi and red bus wait with breathtaking patience for the pedestrians to finish their grand migration.
captions.humorous_tech: Large crowds of pedestrians deploy across the zebra crossings of a busy city intersection. A red bus and yellow taxi wait on the perimeter, pausing their processes until the human traffic merge is complete.
captions.humorous_non_tech: Masses of pedestrians flood the wide zebra crossings of a busy city intersection, while a red bus and yellow taxi watch from the sidelines like they've just realized they aren't the main characters.

captions.formal: A person wearing yellow shoes kicks a white and blue soccer ball on a green turf field at dusk. The camera pulls back to reveal two individuals in blue and maroon shirts running right.
captions.sarcastic: A person in bright yellow shoes executes a daring kick of a soccer ball on a turf field at dusk, while two others in blue and maroon shirts sprint away as if fleeing the scene.
captions.humorous_tech: A person in yellow shoes deploys a white and blue soccer ball on a green turf field at dusk. The camera zooms out as two players in blue and maroon shirts run right to handle the resulting prod incident.
captions.humorous_non_tech: A person in yellow shoes kicks a white and blue soccer ball on a green turf field at dusk, while two runners in blue and maroon shirts flee the scene like they just saw a ghost.

captions.formal: Chopped red onion, red peppers, and mushrooms in a black frying pan are tossed over an open flame on a metal grate. Smoke and steam rise as the vegetables move in a continuous sequence of tossing motions.
captions.sarcastic: A black frying pan tosses chopped red onion, peppers, and mushrooms over an open flame on a metal grate. It is a truly daring performance, bravely throwing vegetables into the air and then immediately catching them.
captions.humorous_tech: A black frying pan tosses chopped red onion, red peppers, and mushrooms over an open flame on a metal grate. The vegetables are repeatedly deployed into the air, cycling through a high-frequency loop of cooking.
captions.humorous_non_tech: Chopped mushrooms, red peppers, and red onion in a black frying pan are tossed repeatedly over an open flame on a metal grate, like a group of vegetables experiencing a very stressful theme park ride.

captions.formal: A camera tilts upward past dark tree branches with small green leaves during a rain shower. Bright sunlight breaks through the foliage, creating a lens flare against a blurred landscape and structure.
captions.sarcastic: Dark branches with small green leaves endure a rain shower, only for the sun to aggressively blind the camera with a lens flare as it tilts toward the canopy. Truly a masterful display of mixed weather signals.
captions.humorous_tech: The camera tilts up through dark branches and rain, attempting a slow deploy toward the canopy. The process concludes with a critical system crash as bright sunlight triggers a total white-out lens flare.
captions.humorous_non_tech: Raindrops fall through dark branches with small green leaves as the view tilts toward the canopy, where the sun suddenly bursts through as if to remind the trees they aren't allowed to be moody.

captions.formal: A person wearing black-rimmed glasses stares forward against a dark background. Blue digital code and alphanumeric characters scroll vertically across the subject's face and lenses in a static close-up shot.
captions.sarcastic: A person in black-rimmed glasses stares blankly into a dark void while blue digital code scrolls across their face, clearly performing the grueling labor of looking like a cinematic hacker.
captions.humorous_tech: A person in black-rimmed glasses stares forward against a dark background, their face and lenses reflecting scrolling blue code like a developer staring at a critical production incident in real-time.
captions.humorous_non_tech: A person in black-rimmed glasses stares forward against a dark background while glowing blue text scrolls across their face like someone trying to read the terms and conditions of a very long contract.
